objective: Speak with Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

description: You will now be revered within our great city. Any <race> worthy of completing the Rites of the Earthmother earns that honor.
For your final quest, seek out our noble leader, Cairne Bloodhoof, who dwells atop the highest mesa in Thunder Bluff.
completion: Hail, young <class>. I see you found your way to my doorstep.
